notes: Spark-X2.6-4B_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Spark-X2.6-4B: the INT8 file of the 4B = the 4B CPU file. XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B (Apache-2.0) converted to LiteRT-LM; the bundle carries templates/spark26_think.jinja (the vendor template's plain-chat part, thinking on by default, reasoning_effort high or low through extra_context), a `thought` channel and the repo's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Published 2026-10-31 (Hub main f8da7265 at the read). Measured 2026-11-01 in the run r6.
quantization: dynamic INT8 (per-channel INT8 weights on every linear and the embedding, FP32 activations declared): litert-torch 0.9.3 export (dynamic_wi8_afp32), the exported graph (no GPU rewrite), prefer_activation_type fp32, 6 prefill signatures, KV cache 4,096
